data.name: Abbaas
data.gender_notes: Abbaas is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Abbaas is a name derived from the Arabic language, which means 'Servant of Allah'. In Islamic history, Abbaas ibn Abdul Muttalib was a respected figure and the uncle of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). He played a significant role in the early Muslim community and was a symbol of devotion and servitude to Allah. The name Abbaas carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abbaas usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A constant reminder of one's servitude to Allah
data.etymology: Abbaas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abbaas total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عبااس
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عبااس يعود أصله إلى اللغة العربية، وتعني الحماسة والجريان
in_arabic.long_meaning: يأتي اسم عبااس من الاسم العربي عبااس، والذي يعني الحماسة والجريان. ويعتبر هذا الاسم من أهم أسماء الرجال في الإسلام، حيث يرتبط بالحسين بن علي، أحد الأئمة الاثنا عشر في الشيعة. والذي قُتل في معركة كربلا في العراق. وكان هذا العباس من بين الذين وقفوا مع الحسين بن علي ضد الحكم الأموي في ذلك الوقت. والاسم يرمز إلى الشجاعة والصبر والتصميم، مما يعكس شخصيتها البطولية في التاريخ الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: عبااس
in_urdu.meaning: عبااس نام کا مطلب ہے حماسی اور جاری ہونا، یہ اسلامی ناموں میں مقبول ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عبااس نام کا مطلب ہے حماسی اور جاری ہونا، یہ نام عربی زبان میں ہے جس کا مطلب ہے شجاع اور صبور ہونا. یہ نام اپنے عظمت و جلال کے لیے مشہور ہے. اور یہ نام اسلامی ناموں میں بھی ایک اہم حیثیت رکھتا ہے. لہذا اگر آپ اپنے بچے کو ایک اسلامی نام دیں تو عبااس نام بہت اچھا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अब्बास
in_hindi.meaning: अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम, जिसका अर्थ है उत्साह और बहाव
in_hindi.long_meaning: अब्बास नाम का अर्थ है उत्साह और बहाव. यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है शौर्य और साहस. यह नाम मुस्लिम परिवारों में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इसका महत्व भी बहुत अधिक है. यह नाम अपने जादुई और अद्वितीय महत्व के लिए जाना जाता है. इसका उपयोग पुरुषों के लिए किया जाता है और यह नाम एक अच्छा विकल्प हो सकता है.

in_pashto.name: عبااس
in_pashto.meaning: عبااس نوم دې معنا لري چټکتيا او ځورېدل
in_pashto.long_meaning: عبااس نوم دې معنا لري چټکتيا او ځورېدل. یو ښه نام دی چې د مومنانو لپاره ښه دی. دا نوم د افغانستان د تاریخي شخصیتونو په مننت دی. دا نوم د ډېرو مومنانو لپاره ښه دی. دا نوم د ډېرو مومنانو په لومړي نوم کې دی. دا نوم داسې ځانګړتیا لري چې د ډېرو مومنانو په دلته دی.

in_english.name: Abbaas
in_english.meaning: Arabic name meaning enthusiasm and flow, popular in Islamic names
in_english.long_meaning: The name Abbaas is of Arabic origin and means enthusiasm and flow. It is a popular name in Islamic tradition and is associated with the Prophet Muhammad's uncle, Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib. The name connotes bravery, patience, and determination, reflecting the personality traits of the eponymous figure in Islamic history. It is also associated with the concept of al-'Abaas, which refers to the enthusiasm and fervor of the believers in their pursuit of righteousness.

historical_references.reference: Abbas ibn Abdul Muttalib, the uncle of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the commander of the Prophet's army during the Battle of Uhud. He was also known as Abbas ibn Abdul-Muttalib al-Sabaki or Abbas ibn Abdul-Muttalib al-Hashimi.
historical_references.context: Before Islam, Abbas was an influential Meccan leader and an important figure in the pre-Islamic Arabian society. After Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) migration to Medina, Abbas became one of the earliest converts to Islam and was appointed as the commander of the Muslim army during the Battle of Uhud in 625 CE.

historical_references.reference: Abbas ibn Firnas, a prominent Andalusian polymath who is considered one of the earliest aviators in history. He is known for attempting to fly using a glider in the late 9th century CE (around 852 CE).
historical_references.context: Abbas ibn Firnas was born in Cordoba, Spain, during the Umayyad Caliphate. He was known for his scientific and artistic achievements, including his works in aviation, music, and poetry. Abbas' attempt to fly using a glider, though unsuccessful, marked a significant step towards human flight.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Abbas is of Arabic origin and is derived from the name Ibrahim's uncle, Abbas ibn Abdul Muttalib. Today, the name Abbas is primarily associated with individuals connected to Islamic history, particularly Abbas ibn Ali, a prominent figure in Shia Islam, and the Abbasid Caliphate, a major Islamic empire that ruled much of the Middle East from the 8th to the 13th centuries. In modern times, the name Abbas is also used as a given name in various Muslim communities and beyond. It is important to note that the usage of the name Abbas can vary greatly depending on cultural and regional contexts.
